title: AI outbound intelligence system · B2B SaaS
description: Replaced a scattered, spreadsheet-driven outbound motion with a structured AI agent stack: ICP-scored account enrichment, research-grounded sequence drafting, and CRM logging in one operator loop. 50 accounts from cold CSV to sequenced and logged in under an hour.
problem: The team was doing outbound from a spreadsheet: manual research, generic templates, no ICP scoring logic. AI tools had been tried and abandoned because they made bad inputs faster, not better outputs. The bottleneck wasn't effort — it was the absence of a system.
system: Built in three stages. First: ICP definition with real firmographic and behavioral specifics — specific enough to score any account and get a consistent answer. Second: CRM cleanup to give the enrichment layer clean data to work against. Third: Claude Code agent stack with four MCP tools and five operator skills covering research, ICP scoring, sequence drafting, and CRM logging.
artifact: Operator agent stack with CLAUDE.md client brief, named skills for each workflow step, and a per-account research and log structure. Runs unattended for enrichment, review-gated for sequence approval.
outcome: Outbound moved from spreadsheet-and-intuition to a structured, auditable system. Fit scores are consistent across runs. Copy is grounded in actual account research. The operator reviews and approves; the agent handles the research and drafting overhead.
